. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on how many players there were in the match. The rewards you received were based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. This map had two difficulties, Easy and Hard.

Cash was only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreased by 25%, which means that in a trio, you only got 50% of the cash. This amount was distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which was 12.5% in duo and 16.7% in trio. If it was a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it got rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down. For example, the

We managed to supply you with a new mercenary, they should help you neutralize whatever comes your way. Save the thanks for if we survive. Here they come, make sure they don't get to that computer while we work on the portal.
There must be hundreds of them coming through... if not thousands. Stay vigilant.
These guys.. look different than before. Something must've corrupted everything after the Conserver fell.
Got confirmation. That's a real god cube alright. The Children of Exo weren't joking around, huh? Have to hand it to 'em, I'm impressed.
The portal on the other side had its energy source replaced, it's too powerful for us to close it.
Got word that the previous realm has no information on any other records. It was disconnected from the entire Realm network.
I'm assuming the Conserver is what kept it off the grid until the Children of Exo forced it open. We're trying to find a way to reverse it.
Good grief, These guys are relentless. Whatever is keeping this thing open is 100% headed towards the portal with them.
Heads up, some pretty hefty hoards coming your way.
Got some news. We might not be able to close this portal, so we'll just have to do this the old fashioned way.
Got more info. This Realm has only been accessed by an offline server network that's not connected to the main realm.
This is more than likely EXO's private realm network. We are positive there's at least an undiscovered fragment in there, but we're trying to figure out what has it.
For now, we sent an emergency notification to all Realms to close off access. We cannot let them re-program and spread across the whole network.
I swear.. we've heard this before. Give me one second.
We got a match. This.. sound was logged from the Overture incident. It's believed to be a powerful entity infected by the fragments.
This entity.. was likely taken by EXO sometime after we defeated the Umbra. But what is it doing here?
HAHAHAHA! DIDN'T EXPECT TO SEE ME BACK SO SOON EH? IF YOU THOUGHT THE CHILDREN OF EXO ARE ANOTHER FREAKAZOID CULT WITH MORE BRAWN THAN BRAINS, THEN GUESS AGAIN! HAHAHAHA!
Talk about obsessed. Looks like he managed to get a taste of a fragment too. Lovely..

I MUST SAY, IT'S ASTONISHING HOW OFTEN YOUR ORGANIZATION KEEPS GETTING PLAYED INTO OUR HANDS, AND IF YOU THINK THIS WHOLE SITUATION CAN BE RESOLVED, WELL YOU'LL FIND OUT SOON THAT YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S COMING!
0-2, Good work. Let's get back to it.
I'm not sure the Children of Exo came here by accident.. From the numbers, it seems too convenient.
I'm getting readings of higher levels of radiation. Whatever this thing is.. it's getting close. Brace yourselves.
None of you intruders should've entered my realm...
This guy just doesn't know when to give up! You know what to do.. Take 'em out!
You have released something the moment you defeated me that I have been conserving for so long... Now there's no way you're stopping it.
.. We've faced worse and we've succeeded each time. Let's add this one to the tally.
We have a reading.. whatever it is, it's beyond the portal. Godspeed.
, I thought they were merely.. a myth!
